axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

members.tone: The one member whose excess can flatter, registering a degree far past what was expected as remarkable rather than as a fault.
Sizes an excess by calling it a wrong, so the same far-more-than-expected that *extraordinary* admires becomes something to answer for.
Names the utmost degree flatly, measuring how far a quantity, amount or degree sits from the norm without ruling on whether that is a fault.
Purely positional: it sets an opinion or action out past the norm and leaves the verdict to whoever is looking, where *outrageous* is all verdict.
Absolute rather than excessive, saying a thing is complete or extreme with nothing softening it, so its force is bleakness rather than blame.
Convicts the overstepping of having no argument for itself, a heavier charge than the plain over-the-limit of *excessive*.
Informal and dry, registering a large overshoot as a grumble rather than the protest that *outrageous* makes of the same gloss.
The flat statement of the case, that the limit has been passed, without the indignation *unreasonable* adds to it.
Formal and cool, sizing the overshoot rather than complaining about it as *unreasonable* does.
The hottest word here: the excess is treated as an affront, and the word demands that someone object.
Faults the excess for not being warranted rather than for its bulk, the quietest complaint among the words sharing its gloss.
Marks opinions and actions as standing well past the norm by commitment rather than by accident of degree, and eyes that commitment with reserve.
A bare intensifier of position that shoves an opinion or action to the far edge and says nothing about it beyond how far out it sits.
